jobs.title: Director of Development
jobs.description:
Description:
**Department:** Development

**Reports to:** Executive Director

**Position:** Director of Development

**Employment Type:** Full\-time, exempt, salaried and benefited

**Agency Description:** We provide affordable, bilingual, and accessible mental health services for people of all ages living in Napa County. Our vision is to create a community of enduring strength by equipping children, youth, adults, and seniors with the tools they need to live emotionally healthy and stable lives through programs ranging from prevention to mental health treatment.

**Position Summary:** The Development Director (DD) leads and oversees all aspects of the agency’s philanthropic and communications activities. Working closely with the Executive Director, Executive Leadership team, Board of Directors, and Development staff, the DD drives dynamic development, builds donor relationships, and marketing strategies that meet and exceed the agency’s goals.


**Duties and Responsibilities**


Leadership \& Strategy

* Works closely with Executive Director, Leadership Team, and Board Development Committee to create and implement annual and long\-term development and marketing strategies that help meet and exceed the agency’s revenue, service delivery, and community engagement goals.
* Leads Board Development/Stewardship Committee, strategically leveraging its membership to support community engagement and fundraising initiatives
* Strategically supports Marketing Committee
* Develop and monitor annual Development revenue targets and expense budget with an eye toward maximizing fundraising efficiency and ROI on expenses.


Gifts and Philanthropy

* Develop and cultivate donor relationships as well as solicit funds.
* Leads Mentis giving program, working closely with ED, Board, and Development committee to ensure regular (at least quarterly) engagement with all donors.
* Builds, sustains, and models a culture of stewardship, emphasizing long\-term relationship\-building over continual asking.
* Manages a personal portfolio of donors in conjunction with ED as well as supports ED with ongoing major donor engagement.
* Works with ED, Board, and Development committee to continually identify and cultivate potential new major donors.


Events and Fundraising

* Oversee execution of Mentis’ community engagement events, including Jeffersonian Dinner series, Blue Skies Ahead reception, Mental Health Awareness Month event, Donor breakfast, and potential other events, and annual fundraising campaigns, including end\-of\-year giving, monthly giving, Mental Health Awareness Month, Suicide Prevention Month, and others throughout the year.
* Support the Development Team in project\-managing all events and fundraising campaigns, including workplan tracking, budget monitoring, and supervising team tasks.
* Oversee messaging, guest experience and strategy, ensuring that all events and campaigns are executed with high fidelity to the Mentis brand and agency values.


Institutional Funding

* Work with Grant management consultant (who will write larger grants) and other directors on smaller/local grants, to manage annual grants pipeline, ensuring that all proposal and reporting deadlines are met and that continual prospect research identifies new funding opportunities.
* Coordinate with program staff where needed to gather program data and other content for grant proposals and reports.


Communications \& Marketing

* Work with the Development Team to develop an engaging annual communications strategy and plan that meets the agency’s community engagement and fundraising goals.
* Support Development Team in creating and publishing engaging materials for a variety of audiences—including press releases, columns, media pitches, e\-blasts, advertisements, radio features, event promotion materials, impact reports, and more.
* Serve as Mentis spokesperson along with other directors and board members, representing the agency in public through presentations, media interviews, and local event attendance.


Administration

* Develop and monitor annual development budget in conjunction with ED and Finance Director.
* Work with Development Team to analyze monthly reports on fundraising revenue and progress toward goals.


Supervision

* Provide effective and supportive supervision for Development Team.
* Encourage and provide professional growth opportunities.
* Monitor performance and provide guidance, support, and oversight where needed.


Other Duties as Assigned

**Salary** **and Benefits:**


Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including education, experience, and skill set.


**Benefits** for our regular full\-time employees include the following:


Earn up to 12 vacation days per year

* Earn up to 10 sick days per year
* Enjoy 12 holidays per year, plus a winter break (3 days)
* Up to 90% paid premium for medical and fully covered dental premium for the employee
* Vision and Dental Plans
* 401k retirement plan
* EAP Program
* Annual training allowance
* Paid time off for training


Mentis is an equal opportunity employer who does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.


California Pay Transparency Disclaimer: This is an Exempt position. The pay range for this position is $115,000 to $125,000/year \- based on experience and track record in development.

**Please** **submit** **your resume and cover letter** **to** jobs@mentisnapa.org

jobs.title: Chief Executive Officer, Chicago Quantum Exchange
jobs.description:
**Department**


PME Chicago Quantum Exchange (CQE) **About the Department**


The Chicago Quantum Exchange (CQE) is an intellectual hub in the Midwest that connects leading universities, national labs, and industry partners to advance the science and engineering of quantum information, train the future quantum workforce, and drive the quantum economy. The CQE is based at the University of Chicago and anchored by the US Department of Energy’s Argonne National Laboratory and Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory, the University of Illinois Urbana\-Champaign, the University of Wisconsin–Madison, Northwestern University, and Purdue University. The community includes more than 50 corporate, international, nonprofit, and regional partners and is one of the largest collaborative teams working on quantum science in the world. The CQE leads national initiatives, including The Bloch Quantum Tech Hub, a US Economic Development Administration (EDA) designation endorsing the Chicago metro area as a central driver of US leadership in quantum technologies.  

  

The Pritzker School of Molecular Engineering (UChicago PME) is the first school in the nation dedicated to molecular engineering, and integrates science and engineering to address global challenges from the molecular level up. UChicago PME’s rigorous academic and research programs are enhanced through the University of Chicago’s unique partnership with Argonne and Fermi National Laboratories, and the broad excellence of scholarship and education on campus. In the next phase of growth as a School, PME will continue to expand its team of world\-class faculty researchers and empower students from diverse backgrounds to collaborate with faculty in cutting\-edge facilities. PME aims to bring solutions for urgent societal problems to the forefront, while training the next generation of scientific leaders and entrepreneurs. **Job Summary**


The CEO of the Chicago Quantum Exchange develops and executes strategic plans to build a discovery\-to\-deployment research, innovation and commercialization, and talent ecosystem across the CQE member community, an external network of companies, non\-profits, and others. They will lead a team of skilled professionals and area managers to further CQE’s mission and vision, including the CQE’s Bloch Quantum EDA Tech Hub. Reporting to the CQE Faculty Director, this individual must be able to thrive in a fast\-moving, decentralized environment. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on leader able to set a vision to drive change internally; they have a can do, positive attitude, and are passionate about selling a strategic vision to key stakeholders including local and national leadership, faculty, and other internal and external partners.**Responsibilities**

* In alignment with the Faculty Director, designs, implements, and manages CQE’s overall growth strategy, furthering its mission, enabling its vision, and fostering novel quantum research, education and workforce development, and innovation and commercialization initiatives throughout the Quantum Prairie of Illinois, Indiana, and Wisconsin.
* Interacts with key stakeholders, internal leadership, external partners, and others to broker deals, continue to enhance CQE’s position and reputation, and grow CQE’s constellation of members and industry and other partnerships.
* Builds revenue\-generating programming, such as dues\-based memberships or partnerships and educational offerings, with an eye toward organizational sustainability.
* Understands the quantum marketplace and competitive dynamics and implications, including social and economic trends that impact CQE’s position and goals for growth and revenue.
* Enables advantageous positioning for CQE in consultation with leadership and key stakeholders to promote prominence in quantum\-related endeavors in the region.
* Pursues, through partnerships and direct reports, research collaborations, professional and other educational offerings and programs, and business development for the region.
* Through a diversified team of skilled professionals, drives awareness that aids in recruiting faculty, students, philanthropic and other sponsors, and industry partners.
* Establishes programs supported by federal and philanthropic funders, as well as the methodologies to measure, track and course\-correct.
* Builds a global profile for the CQE, and ensures the identity, voice, and objectives are articulated broadly to advantageous effect.
* Anticipates and solves a range of complex problems; work assignments are difficult and broad in nature, usually requiring creativity, originality, and ingenuity.
* Creates and implements data\-driven tools for measuring success and identifying opportunities for expansion in this emerging space.
* Provides strategic leadership for a Center with senior management and serves as a liaison to academic departments, professional organizations and administrative units of the University.
* Manages multiple related teams. Establishes department priorities, is responsible for the management of the center budget, allocates resources and executes strategic plans.
* Performs other related work as needed.

jobs.title: Development Director - Texas Bar Foundation
jobs.description:
General Description:

Reports directly to the Executive Director. Responsibilities to include cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship of individual and corporate sponsorship support for the Texas Bar Foundation. Performs the duties of planning, organizing, directing, and coordinating special development efforts.  

Primary Functions:
* Works closely with the Fellows Chair, Development Committee, and seventeen district area chairs to develop and implement fundraising strategies, solicit and secure funds, cultivate existing donors, and acquire new donors. Responsible for training and recruiting materials.
* Trains, manages, and stewards volunteer solicitors. Assists in acquiring 200\+ volunteers in the 17 districts.
* Oversees the Development Committee and develops and manages endowment fundraising initiatives, including identifying, cultivating, soliciting, and stewarding donors and prospects to secure long\-term philanthropic support.
* Develops and oversees planned giving initiatives, including cultivating prospective legacy donors, coordinating planned gift outreach, and stewarding donors who have included the organization in their estate plans.
* Manages achievement award program: supports the selection committees, conducts oral history interviews, produces plaques and mementos, and writes the printed program and presentation scripts.
* Performs duties of planning, organizing, and implementing fundraising events and the annual dinner.
* Maintains accurate and detailed data regarding solicitation activities and creates tracking reports.
* Represents Bar Foundation in communications with donors, volunteers, Board members, and external stakeholders and provides a high level of customer service.
* Adheres to the budget and manages details for development\-related events, programs, fundraising initiatives, and vendor relationships.
* Assists with committee and Board meeting minutes and quarterly Board dinners and meetings and works with Board members to support development and fundraising initiatives.
* Responsible for updating donor information in Raisers Edge, and coordinates with Marketing and Communications Coordinator to produce and distribute memorial certificates, Life Fellow plaques, new Fellow certificates, and press releases. Directs and monitors vendors and mass mailings.
* Uses data strategically to produce accurate documents and reports. Requires proficiency in merge documents, database queries, and exports.
* Other duties as assigned.


Position Requirements:

The ideal candidate will have an entrepreneurial and strategic approach to fundraising. Bachelor’s degree plus three years of professional experience required, preferably in fundraising or membership development with a nonprofit organization. Supervisory experience preferred. Excellent interpersonal, written communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to take initiative and work independently and as part of a team. Experience and demonstrated success with annual giving, major donor programs, and/or individual and corporate solicitation preferred. Active membership in the Association of Fundraising Professionals (AFP) and/or other professional associations preferred. Knowledge of MS Word, Excel, and Access required; Raiser’s Edge preferred. Requires strong attention to detail, professionalism, and discretion. Position requires frequent overnight travel statewide.
